title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Seeing a cut that takes too much
summary: Given one extra line at the end of every cut, the witness for unreferenced declarations reported zero on all 98, and 5 of those delete live code.

highlights.title: The neighbour rule sees two lines now
highlights.description: The invariant that counts declarations inside a cut anchored on `^` with no multiline flag, so it only ever matched at offset zero. It caught two declarations on ONE line, the shape it was built for, and was blind to two on two lines.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The invariant that catches a cut swallowing its neighbour now sees a neighbour on the next line, not only one after a semicolon.
Parentheses are blanked like braces before counting, so a constructor parameter is not mistaken for a neighbour of its class.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Precision, not just sensitivity: it reports the 5 damaging cases and none of the 93 harmless ones. On class members, 125 caught out of 320 instead of 47.
